text:
carmen: seeing spikes of 502s from edge-proxy -> backend in ap-southeast2 around 10:08 UTC. health checks still show healthy but traffic fails intermittently.
aj: ugh, any logs? which backend?
carmen: proxy logs show upstream connect failures: 
```
[2026-03-17T10:07:58Z] error: connect() to 10.200.45.23:50023 failed (111: Connection refused) while connecting to upstream, client: 52.8.8.8, server: edge-proxy
```
samir: ALB/targets look healthy, but connection attempts getting reset. did we change network rules recently?
leo: checked infra audit — compliance CI applied a NACL update last night that limited outbound ports on the edge subnets to 50000-50050 for a test. here's the change id: nacl-change-2026-03-17T22:10Z. infra-bot flagged it.
infra-bot: applied change nacl-change-2026-03-17T22:10Z (author: compliance-ci) on subnet sn-edge-apse2-a: allow outbound ports 50000-50050, deny others.
samir: that would break normal ephemeral port behavior. our proxies open ephemeral source ports to backend ephemeral/listener ports; restricting ephemeral ranges to such a tiny window will drop most SYNs.
carmen: confirmed with tcpdump on backend instance 10.200.45.23: 
```
12:07:56.123456 IP 10.200.45.7.34012 > 10.200.45.23.443: Flags [S], seq 0
12:07:56.124001 IP 10.200.45.7.34013 > 10.200.45.23.443: Flags [S], seq 0
# no SYN-ACK recorded
```
aj: ok we need a quick mitigation — widening the NACL is fastest. I'm adding an allow rule for ephemeral 1024-65535 on the affected NACL with a high priority. will post rule id when done.
leo: pls also add a targeted SG exception if possible; NACLs are stateless so ephemeral on both sides matters.
aj: mitigation applied: nacl-rule-allow-ephemeral-1024-65535 (id nacl-allow-ephemeral-1919). 502s dropped to near zero within 2 mins. :thumbsup:
carmen: nice. what's the long-term fix?
samir: rollback the overly-restrictive compliance rule and update the compliance CI to exclude edge subnets (or use an explicit allowlist for test instances). also add a unit test in terraform pipeline that simulates an edge proxy TCP handshake.
leo: I'll open a PR on infra repo with: 1) revert/exception for edge subnets, 2) comment and doc in NACLS module, 3) add terraform test and a small e2e that runs tcpdump check.
aj: create runbook for this exact symptom: "edge 502s + NACL ephemeral too narrow" and link it. Carmen pls add the logs snippet to the runbook.
carmen: added logs + tcpdump snippet to runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/edge-nacl-ephemeral.md
infra-bot: incident created INC-2026-048: "Edge proxy 502s due to NACL ephemeral port narrowing" assigned to eng-infra oncall.
samir: estimate: PR + CI tests today, deploy tomorrow morning with canary. after that we'll coordinate with compliance to change default policy.
aj: will also add an alert to watch for spike in upstream connect errors and a daily job to verify NACLs on edge subnets haven't drifted.
carmen: thanks team — mitigation helped. leaving follow-ups in the PR and runbook. :heart:
